overall_notes: This paper is primarily about text-to-SQL parsing (semantic parsing/specialized code generation) rather than general natural language generation. While it involves natural language interaction, the main output is SQL queries, not natural language text. The evaluation metrics (SQLAcc, ExeAcc) are specific to SQL generation accuracy. The human evaluation focuses on SQL correctness rather than NLG quality metrics like fluency or coherence.
